title: Fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations on an open interval (continuous version)
statement: Let a, b be reals and g : ℝ → ℝ continuous on (a, b). Suppose ∫_ℝ χ(x)·g(x) dx = 0 for every C^∞ function χ : ℝ → ℝ with compact support and tsupport χ ⊆ (a, b). Then g(x) = 0 for every x ∈ (a, b).
lean_statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn g (Ioo a b) → (∀ χ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ → HasCompactSupport χ → tsupport χ ⊆ Ioo a b → ∫ x, χ x * g x = 0) → ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, g x = 0
